name: ryu.kernel
description: Kernel cloud browsers for Ryu's swappable browser.control layer, over Kernel's hosted OAuth MCP server. A Kernel browser session is the browser.* tab id: each navigate creates a new session on the URL, tabs lists live sessions, and screenshot, click_at, key, scroll, and drag drive it by viewport coordinates. Element-reference verbs stay unbound because Kernel controls the browser by pixels; the full Kernel tool set (Playwright execution, browser REPL, profiles, replays, files) remains available under kernel.*.

kernel.description: Kernel remote OAuth MCP server. Native tools include manage_browsers, computer_action, execute_playwright_code, browser_repl, profiles, proxies, replays, browser files, and documentation search.
